Full-ownership senior software engineer responsible for building and evolving a new system in TypeScript that is replacing our existing one.

We expect you to use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work. Not occasionally — daily. Your velocity, code quality, and problem-solving should reflect effective AI tool use. Features from requirements to production: you break them down, build them, ship them, monitor them

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

Location: Doha, Dubai, or London
Type: Full-time
Level: Mid or senior

Breakmark is partnering with an AI company that builds software for complex, data-heavy operations. Its teams work closely with enterprise and government customers, bringing fragmented data together to help people make better decisions in live operational settings.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work directly with customers to understand how their operations function, deploy existing products, and build software for problems that have yet to be solved. You’ll own deployments from kickoff through go-live, working with real data, legacy systems, and evolving requirements.

What you’ll do

 - Lead customer deployments and take ownership of the outcome.

 - Spend time on-site to understand workflows, users, and operational challenges.

 - Build and adapt full-stack software using TypeScript, React, and Python or Node.js.

 - Turn customer needs into clear engineering work and iterate with users in live environments.

 - Identify which solutions should become reusable product capabilities.

What we’re looking for

 - At least 2–4 years of full-stack engineering experience, with strong TypeScript and React skills.

 - Experience shipping working software and improving it through direct user feedback.

 - The ability to manage a customer deployment from kickoff through go-live.

 - Clear communication with both technical teams and customers.

 - Comfort working with ambiguous requirements and messy data.

 - Willingness to spend significant time at customer sites and travel frequently across the Gulf and beyond.

This role suits an engineer who enjoys being close to the problem, building quickly, and seeing their work used in real operations.

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

Our Business Intelligence and Analytics team is seeking to grow the company’s Data Science and Machine Learning capabilities across several facets of our business. We are seeking a seasoned Data Scientist to lead this transformative step change function and nurture its growth across several focus areas. You will drive tactical and strategic execution of several data science projects and manage their entire lifecycle.

Drive the long-term statistical modeling and machine learning vision of the company.
Conducting exploratory data analysis (EDA) prior to model development
Performing feasibility assessments (POCs) for proposed ML solutions
Monitoring and diagnosing model performance issues, including drift and degradation
Researching and evaluating additional use cases for existing models
Supporting ad hoc ML-related analytics requests from stakeholders and senior data scientists

Design, prototype, and implement models across several domains. Manage each part of a project’s life cycle, including ad-hoc exploration, preparation of training data, model development, and production deployment.
Work with product and marketing managers, analysts, and engineers to turn insights about our users into automated services.

BA/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science required. Masters Degree in a quantitative or scientific discipline strongly desired.
3+ years experience in developing, testing, and deploying optimized predictive models (preferably to inform in-product recommendation systems and automated customer re-targeting efforts).
Advanced statistical modeling skillset (Python, R, etc).
Advanced SQL querying, data mining, and data cleansing skillset.
Deep knowledge of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms (neural networks, decision trees, etc.).
Advanced knowledge of experiment design.
Experience with Seldon-core or other MLOps tools is preferred.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure tools (AWS EC2, S3, Redshift, Snowflake, containers).
Advanced visualization/reporting and presentation experience.
Version Control Experience (GitHub).
Demonstrated experience adopting and effectively leveraging AI tools in day-to-day data science workflows.
Familiarity with ML deployment infrastructure (ETL, tools, new products in the space).
Excellent strategic project planning skillset.
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).
Experience at an e-commerce or fintech company is a plus.

Ability to develop project plans and deliver results against quarterly and annual roadmaps.
Comfortable working with loosely defined requirements where you exercise your creativity and analytical skills to deliver best in class solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication. Ability to articulate vision, complex thoughts, analytical processes, and results in clear business terms.
Anticipate business needs and think with a business owner mindset – think critically about analyses and solutions and provide improvement recommendations. This role requires an individual who can work autonomously.
